name: Valencina de la Concepción (Spain)
description: White field with stripes of yellow and blue along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valencina de la Concepción (a dolmen and a castle on red, a star and a tower on white).
history: Municipal flag of Valencina de la Concepción; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valencina de la Concepción arms — dolmen and castle on red, star and tower on white
